title: A/B test: two-proportion z-test with power and required n
rationale: Pins dap.ab_test on 10/100 control and 20/100 treatment conversions with alpha 0.05, target power 0.8, mde 0.2 and baseline 0.10: the pooled z, its two-sided p-value, the achieved power for the observed effect, the Fleiss required sample size (3841 per group) and the echoed mde/alpha.

config.sql: SELECT i < 10 AS converted, 'control' AS variant FROM range(100) AS t(i) UNION ALL SELECT i < 20 AS converted, 'treatment' AS variant FROM range(100) AS t(i)

notes: Expectations from the Fleiss formulas with the normal CDF/quantile of Python's statistics.NormalDist: z = 1.9802950859533488, p = 0.04767038065616136, achieved power = 0.5081910681877364, required n = 3841 per group.
